name: Mao P’ang
bio: Mao P’ang (毛滂; Mao Pang; 1056–c. 1124) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 惜分飞 (Xi fen fei)
poems.author: Mao P’ang
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
泪湿阑干花著露。
愁到眉峰碧聚。
此恨平分取。
更无言语。
空相觑。
短雨残云无意绪。
寂寞朝朝暮暮。
今夜山深处。
断魂分付。
潮回去。
